steps.text: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild, south of Burthorpe.
choices: I'm a hero, may I apply to join?
I'll start looking for all those things then.

steps.text: You need to get an oily rod. Talk to Gerrant in Port Sarim to get some slime.
choices: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.text: Combine the harralander potion (unf) with the blamish snail slime.
Use the Blamish oil on your fishing rod.
Go to Taverley Dungeon. As you're 70 Agility, you don't need a dusty key.
Go to Taverley Dungeon. Bring a dusty key if you have one, otherwise you can get one in the dungeon.
Squeeze through the obstacle pipe.
Travel through Taverley Dungeon until you reach the Black Knights' Base. Kill the Jailer in the east side of the base for a jail key.
Use the jail key on the south door and talk to Velrak for a dusty key.
choices: So... do you know anywhere good to explore?

steps.text: Enter the gate to the deeper Taverley dungeon.
Fish a lava eel from the lava south of the blue dragons.
Cook the Lava Eel at a range. You cannot fail this.
Talk to Katrine at the Black Arm Gang base in South west Varrock.
choices: Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?

steps.text: Try to enter the house in east Brimhaven.
Talk to Trobert inside.
choices: So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks?
I volunteer to undertake that mission!

steps.text: Equip your black armour and enter the mansion in the north west of Brimhaven.
Talk to Grip.

Get a miscellaneous key from Grip then give it to your partner. Once you've done that, wait for your partner to enter the north east room of the mansion.After that, search the cupboard in the north room to lure Grip there. Your partner should kill them.
choices: So what do my duties involve?
He won't notice me having a quick look.

steps.text: Pick up Grip's keyring
Use Grip's keyring on the treasure room door.
Search the chest in the treasure room for two candlesticks.
Give one of Pete's candlesticks to your partner. Afterwards, return to Katrine with Pete's candlestick
Head into the Phoenix Gang's base in south Varrock.
Talk to Straven.
Talk to Alfonse the Waiter in the restaurant in Brimhaven.
You'll need your partner to give you a miscellaneous key.
Talk to Charlie the Cook in the back of the restaurant.
choices: I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

steps.text: Push the wall to enter Pete's garden.
Use the misc key on the door to the north west.
Wait for your partner to lure Grip into the room next to yours, and kill him with magic/ranged. Afterwards, trade your partner for a candlestick.
Get your candlestick from your partner.
Bring the candlestick back to Straven.
Bring the candlestick back to Straven.
Head to White Wolf Mountain, and mine a rockslide in the northern part.
Take the south east ladder down.
Follow the tunnel south, then go up the ladder there.
Take the east ladder down.
Follow the path around until you reach a ladder, then climb it.
Take the north ladder down.
Kill the Ice Queen for ice gloves.
Pick up the ice gloves.
Travel to Entrana with the monks in Port Sarim.
Kill the entrana firebird on the north of Entrana.
Pick up the fire feather.
Bring Achietties all the items to finish.
